verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an llms.txt is served at https://www.salesforce.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200), so an agent can be pointed at it. However, the visible content links to marketing and training pages such as the AI Agent Course, not Sales Cloud developer or API reference material. missing for 10: evidence that the llms.txt covers Sales Cloud developer/API docs, agent-oriented documentation (e.g. llms-full.txt or markdown docs endpoints), independent or hands-on corroboration of its usefulness for agents.
